name: Debezium Zero Date Fallback Custom Converter

display.label: Target JDBC types
display.description: Comma-separated list of JDBC temporal types this converter applies to. Allowed tokens: DATE, DATETIME, TIMESTAMP. Default: DATE,DATETIME,TIMESTAMP

display.label: DATE zero-date fallback
display.description: Replacement value emitted for MySQL/MariaDB DATE zero-date rows (0000-00-00). Use 'NULL' (or leave unset) to emit null and promote the column schema to optional. Otherwise specify an ISO-8601 date literal (yyyy-MM-dd).

display.label: DATETIME zero-date fallback
display.description: Replacement value emitted for MySQL/MariaDB DATETIME zero-date rows (0000-00-00 00:00:00). Use 'NULL' (or leave unset) to emit null and promote the column schema to optional. Otherwise specify a UTC datetime literal (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss).

display.label: TIMESTAMP zero-date fallback
display.description: Replacement value emitted for MySQL/MariaDB TIMESTAMP zero-date rows. Use 'NULL' (or leave unset) to emit null and promote the column schema to optional. Otherwise specify an ISO-8601 offset datetime literal (e.g. 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z).

display.label: Column selector
display.description: Comma-separated list of regex patterns matched against <database>.<table>.<column>. Only matching columns have this converter applied. Default '.*' matches every column whose JDBC type is in target.types. Default: .*
